deferred_minors.title: Budget NOT_STARTED branch is not handled by the runner main loop
deferred_minors.evidence: run():28-30 writes validation/<id>-not-started.json and returns when remaining <= 30. main():78 then unconditionally opens validation/<id>/result.json, which that branch never creates.
deferred_minors.impact: If the reserved-budget branch is reached, FileNotFoundError prevents a complete remaining-NOT_STARTED ledger and run-budget-terminal receipt. The branch was not reached in this 31.074797766981646-second completed run; it neither invalidates the six preserved outcomes nor permits extra execution.
deferred_minors.severity_basis: Minor for this completed, one-off diagnostic delivery because the recorded run is complete and safely inside budget; not a certification that the runner is reusable under budget exhaustion.
deferred_minors.minimum_followup_scope: Before reuse, a new Astra-scoped driver change should return/handle NOT_STARTED explicitly and preserve the terminal ledger for all unstarted jobs. Preserve current frozen script and raw evidence; no R424 rerun or product/test-source change is needed for this review.

regrade_basis: Reasonable current user receives complete preserved diagnosis; hypothetical reuse under exhausted budget loses summary but does not invalidate current 6 outcomes or production. Minor is deferred only for current scope; no claim of generic driver readiness.
